question: Should OpenClaw treat the released `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py` helper as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`, or should the helper be revived/backported and repaired?
rationale: Automation should not choose between preserving a shipped helper surface and following the newer current-main skill-creation direction.

options.title: Treat the helper as obsolete
options.body: Close or redirect this issue and the linked PR because current main no longer exposes the helper and documents `skill_workshop` as the supported creation path.

options.title: Repair the released helper
options.body: Revive or backport case-insensitive `--resources` parsing with focused tests if maintainers still consider the helper a supported release surface.

recommendation.title: Treat the helper as obsolete
recommendation.body: Close or redirect this issue and the linked PR because current main no longer exposes the helper and documents `skill_workshop` as the supported creation path.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the recent current-main refactor that removed the helper from the supported skill-creator surface.
